notes.title: Almost free
notes.notes:
Tomorrow, July 24th 2020 Steam promises to release first edition of animARide software.
   We wanna give the opportunity to try [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355840/animARide/]animARide[/url] to many users, as possible, and we offered a minimum price [u][b]$0.99![/b][/u]
To go fast, see video "animARide Tutorial". [previewyoutube=HmshS-B09bM;rightthumb]how it works[/previewyoutube].
With main App, we provide [b]free[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1355840/workshop/]Video Content[/url].
For a creators of content, we provide an app "animARide Parser & Editor"(will be soon) and app for iOS "[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/animaride-mvc/id1438542573]animARide MVC[/url]".
For an users of 6DOF motion simulators, we provide an app "animARide SimTools plugin"(will be soon) and "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367801/animARide_6DOF_emulator/]animARide 6DOF emulator[/url]".
[b]We would like to get the maximum feedback from you to fix all bugs and improve our software as much possible![/b]
